claimant_lives_in_uk.description: Whether the claimant lives in the UK.

children.description: A list of children the claimant is claiming for.

lives_with_claimant.description: Whether the child lives with the claimant.

in_approved_education.description: Whether the child is in approved education or training (e.g. A-levels, GCSEs, NVQ up to level 3). Only relevant for children aged 16-19.

in_extension_period.description: Whether the child (aged 16 or 17) has left education and registered with a government-sponsored careers service or the armed forces (qualifying for a 20-week extension).

upkeep_per_week.description: The amount in £ per week the claimant contributes towards the child's upkeep (food, clothes, pocket money, etc.). Only relevant if the child does not live with the claimant.

another_claimant_has_priority.description: Whether another person who also lives with the child has priority for claiming Child Benefit.

another_claimant_lives_with_child.description: Whether someone who lives with the child is already claiming Child Benefit for them.

care_weeks.description: The number of weeks the child has been in local authority care.

care_home_24h_per_week.description: Whether the child spends at least 24 hours per week at home while in local authority care.

hospital_weeks.description: The number of weeks the child has been in hospital or residential accommodation.

claimant_spends_on_child.description: Whether the claimant regularly spends money on the child (e.g. food, clothes, books) while the child is in hospital or residential accommodation.

is_fostered.description: Whether the child is fostered by the claimant.

council_pays_for_child.description: Whether the local council pays towards the child's accommodation or maintenance.

works_24_plus_hours.description: Whether the child works 24 or more hours per week in paid employment.

started_apprenticeship_in_england.description: Whether the child has started an apprenticeship in England.

receives_qualifying_benefits.description: Whether the child receives qualifying benefits in their own right, such as Universal Credit or Employment and Support Allowance.

conversation.author: eligibility_agent
conversation.text:
Hello! I'd be happy to help you determine your eligibility for Child Benefit. To get started, I need to gather some information about your situation.

Let me ask my first question:

**Do you have any children you'd like to claim Child Benefit for? If so, could you tell me their names and ages?**

conversation.author: actor
conversation.text: Hi! Yes, I have one child - my son Alex. He's 8 years old.

conversation.author: eligibility_agent
conversation.text:
Thank you for that information! So you have one son, Alex, who is 8 years old.

Now I need to understand your living situation:

**Do you live with Alex, or does he live with someone else?**

conversation.author: actor
conversation.text: Yes, Alex lives at home with me.

conversation.author: eligibility_agent
conversation.text:
Great, thank you for confirming that. Now I need to understand a bit more about your circumstances to determine eligibility.

**Are you a British citizen or do you have the right to reside in the UK?** For example, are you a UK citizen, or do you have settled status under the EU Settlement Scheme, or another type of visa that gives you the right to reside?

conversation.author: actor
conversation.text: Yes, I live in the UK - I'm in Manchester. I have the right to be here.

conversation.author: eligibility_agent
conversation.text:
Thank you for clarifying that. Just to be thorough, I need to confirm the specific nature of your right to reside:

**Are you a British citizen, or do you have a different immigration status (such as settled status under the EU Settlement Scheme, a visa, or another form of right to reside)?**

conversation.author: eligibility_agent
conversation.text:
Excellent, thank you for confirming that. Now I just need to check one more important detail:

**Is there anyone else who might also be claiming Child Benefit for Alex, or have you agreed with anyone else who has responsibility for Alex that you will be the one to claim?**

conversation.author: actor
conversation.text: No, nobody else is claiming Child Benefit for Alex. It's just me.

conversation.author: eligibility_agent
conversation.text:
Perfect! Thank you for providing all that information. I now have everything I need to assess your eligibility for Child Benefit for Alex.

Based on the information you've provided:

- You live in the UK (Manchester) and are a British citizen with the right to reside
- Alex is 8 years old and lives with you
- You are responsible for Alex and no one else is claiming Child Benefit for him

You meet all the core requirements for Child Benefit eligibility. Since Alex is under 16 and lives with you, and you are responsible for his upkeep, you qualify for Child Benefit for him.

conversation.author: eligibility_agent
conversation.text:
